Definition: to restrict, by act (hold back or in) or word (prohibit)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to restrict, restrain, withhold, shut up, keep back, refrain, forbid; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to shut up; 1a2) to restrain; 1a3) to withhold; 1b) (Niphal) to be restrained; 1c) (Piel) to finish
